text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Everyone has been waiting for this day!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It was by no means an easy road.
Yet, we have finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Reconstruction Support Race.
The GⅠ Kashiwa Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi Racecourse has recovered to the point of being
able to host G1 races. And then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The hometown hero who ventured into Central
makes their triumphant return today!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
We've finally made it to this day, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. So many things happened,
and so many things have changed..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: As regions across the country gradually recovered, my own feelings underwent a major shift as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I no longer intend to take out
my frustration on the JRA."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Simply to surpass a wonderful rival with an even more wonderful run—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The perfect opponent has come for you today, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race commemorating the track's reopening.
Yet, she herself might not have
the slightest desire to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm here to knock you flat, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san...
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Furioso. Heard you wanna
go toe-to-toe with the new generation from the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you already went against Tran, the first one.
So I'm your second opponent, hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll shove my hand up your nostril
and smack your forehead from the inside!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: How...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't quite understand what she meant, but Espoir City was brimming with fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And another thing.
I don't give a damn about charity concerts
or fundraisers, or any of that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Forget about that, I...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pour every ounce of my spirit into this race
and show 'em something totally wicked!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Take this, Furioso.
It's a present from me!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“—I'd like nothing more.
Come at me, Espo-san.”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot afford to lose this race.
For the sake of—Funabashi's future!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Our strength may be equal.
However, my feelings today are stronger.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let us show them the will of Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
That's right!! Win this—!!!!!
You've got to win, Furi-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: We're gonna bounce back from this and climb all the way to the tooooop!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With these expectations, and in my hometown no less.
I can't afford to lose—not today, absolutely not."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With sights set firmly on victory, a new chapter for Furioso begins.
